description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of various video categories, divided into a total of 14 distinct slices. The chart does not include a separate legend; rather, category labels are positioned just outside the perimeter of the pie, while the corresponding percentage values are displayed directly inside each slice. The segments do not appear to be ordered by size. Starting from the largest slice on the right and moving clockwise, the categories are "People Blogs" in brown at 17.2%, "Music" in a muted purple-grey at 2.3%, "Autos Vehicles" in reddish-brown at 4.8%, "Pets Animals" in greenish-grey at 3.9%, "News Politics" in light brown at 4.3%, "Science Technology" in blue-grey at 6.4%, "Comedy" in teal at 5.6%, "Travel Events" in olive green at 4.6%, "Gaming" in dark grey at 6.4%, "Sports" in purplish-grey at 7.7%, "Film Animation" in dark brown at 4.6%, "Entertainment" in purple-grey at 13.9%, "Education" in reddish-brown at 8.7%, and "Howto Style" in dark green at 9.7%. There are no visually emphasized, exploded, or offset slices in the chart.
